tiny-queue

A small promise queue that limits how many async tasks run at the same time. It has no dependencies and works in browsers and servers.

Features

  • Configurable concurrency with a single option
  • Pause and resume the queue at any time
  • Written in TypeScript with full type definitions

Usage

import { Queue } from 'tiny-queue';
const queue = new Queue({ concurrency: 2 });

Roadmap

  • Priority levels for tasks
  • Persist the queue between restarts

Options

OptionDefaultDescription
concurrency1Maximum number of tasks running together
autoStarttrueStart processing as soon as a task is added
